name: Toy Blocks 3D
description: Real 3D (three.js) toy photography: glossy plastic objects on a studded baseplate sitting on a wooden desk, two softbox highlights, a long macro lens with a tilt-shift blur band that makes everything a miniature, pieces that drop in stop-motion steps on twos and click into place, and scenes built tile by tile like bricks pressed onto a plate. Headlines sit on a toy brick with studs. Playful and tactile. Generic bricks only: no brand names. No emoji.
prompt_hint: Write 6-10 scenes (3-5 s each). Every scene has title.kicker + title.main and visual.type "scene3d" with 1-5 objects (cube, house, building, rocket, server, database, coin, chart, gear, person, tree...). Grids and rows of objects read like a toy set; use connect for flows. Short labels (1-3 words). Never use emoji or toy brand names.
best_for: building a business step by step
